[똥피하기 게임.html](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34671405/default.html)
<html lang="ko"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>똥피하기 게임</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#fff7e6;--fg:#4a2b12;--card:#ffffffcc;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#1d140c;--fg:#f3dcc0;--card:#2b1e12cc}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#1d140c;--fg:#f3dcc0;--card:#2b1e12cc}
html,body{height:100%;margin:0}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:'Jua','Apple SD Gothic Neo','Malgun Gothic',sans-serif;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;touch-action:none;user-select:none}
#app{position:relative;width:min(100vw,calc((100vh - 20px)*360/560));aspect-ratio:360/560;max-height:100%}
canvas{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(#bfe9ff,#fdf6d8 70%,#9ad77a 70.1%)}
.ov{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;background:var(--card);border-radius:16px;padding:16px;text-align:center;backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}
.ov.on{display:flex}
.poop{font-size:clamp(42px,15vw,64px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:2px;color:transparent;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#a8672b 0%,#6b3a14 45%,#3d1f08 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-stroke:3px #2e1706;paint-order:stroke fill;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 0 #1f1004);animation:wob 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;position:relative}
.poop small{display:block;font-size:.55em}
@keyframes wob{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-2deg) scale(1)}50%{transform:rotate(2deg) scale(1.04)}}
.swirl{font-size:56px;margin-bottom:-18px;animation:wob 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
button{font:inherit;font-size:22px;padding:12px 34px;border:3px solid #2e1706;border-radius:40px;background:linear-gradient(#b87333,#7a4217);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #2e1706;cursor:pointer}
button:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 2px 0 #2e1706}
button.sub{background:linear-gradient(#ffe7a8,#e8b94f);color:#4a2b12}
input{font:inherit;font-size:20px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:12px;border:2px solid #7a4217;width:70%;text-align:center;background:#fff;color:#333}
#hud{position:absolute;top:8px;left:12px;right:12px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:#4a2b12;pointer-events:none;text-shadow:0 1px 0 #fff}
ol{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;width:88%;max-height:55%;overflow:auto;text-align:left;font-size:19px}
li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:6px 10px;border-bottom:1px dashed #a8672b}
li.me{background:#ffd96655;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700}
.mute{position:absolute;top:36px;right:10px;z-index:5;font-size:18px;padding:2px 9px;border-width:2px;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:none;background:#fffa}
h2{margin:0;font-size:28px}
</style></head><body>
<div id="app">
<canvas id="c" width="360" height="560"></canvas>
<div id="hud"><span id="sc">점수 0</span><span id="bs">최고 0</span></div>
<button id="mute" class="mute">🔊</button><div class="ov on" id="menu"><div class="swirl">💩</div><div class="poop">똥피하기<small>게임</small></div><p style="margin:0">떨어지는 똥을 피해라!<br><small>화면을 누른 채 좌우로 드래그하면 움직여요 (PC는 ← →)</small></p><button id="b-start">시작하기</button><button id="b-rank" class="sub">랭킹</button></div>
<div class="ov" id="rank"><h2>🏆 랭킹</h2><div id="rs" style="font-size:14px"></div><ol id="rl"></ol><button id="b-back" class="sub">돌아가기</button></div>
<div class="ov" id="over"><h2>💥 게임 오버!</h2><div id="fs" style="font-size:34px;font-weight:900"></div><input id="nm" maxlength="8" placeholder="이름 입력"><button id="b-save">랭킹 등록</button><button id="b-again" class="sub">다시하기</button></div>
</div>
<script>
const PIG="data:image/png;base64,",IMGS=["data:image/png;base64,","data:image/png;base64,","data:image/png;base64,","data:image/png;base64,","data:image/png;base64,","data:image/png;base64,","data:image/png;base64,","data:image/png;base64,"];
const c=document.getElementById('c'),x=c.getContext('2d'),W=360,H=560;
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const pig=new Image();pig.src=PIG;
const imgs=IMGS.map(s=>{const i=new Image();i.src=s;return i});
let run=false,px=W/2,tx=W/2,items=[],t=0,score=0,sp=0,last=0,keys={},drag=null,mv=0,acc=0,ded=0,ac=null,muted=false;
let db=null,uid=null,rows=[],shared=false,myBest=0,lastLocal=null,msg='';
/* ---------- sound ---------- */
function squeak(p){if(muted||!ac)return;p=p||1;const n=ac.currentTime;[0,0.14].forEach((d,i)=>{const o=ac.createOscillator(),g=ac.createGain(),f=ac.createBiquadFilter();o.type='sawtooth';f.type='bandpass';f.frequency.value=1500;f.Q.value=2;
 o.frequency.setValueAtTime(650*p,n+d);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1500*p*(i?1.12:1),n+d+0.07);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(950*p,n+d+0.12);
 g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,n+d);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.28,n+d+0.015);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,n+d+0.13);
 o.connect(f);f.connect(g);g.connect(ac.destination);o.start(n+d);o.stop(n+d+0.14)})}
function initAudio(){try{ac=ac||new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();ac.resume()}catch(e){}}
$('mute').onclick=()=>{muted=!muted;$('mute').textContent=muted?'🔇':'🔊';if(!muted){initAudio();squeak()}};
/* ---------- ranking ---------- */
function loadL(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('poopRank')||'[]')}catch(e){return[]}}
function saveL(a){try{localStorage.setItem('poopRank',JSON.stringify(a))}catch(e){}}
function bestNow(){const l=loadL();return Math.max(myBest,l.length?l[0].s:0)}
function updBest(){$('bs').textContent='최고 '+bestNow()}
function show(id){['menu','rank','over'].forEach(k=>$(k).classList.toggle('on',k===id))}
function renderRank(){
 const list=shared?rows:loadL().map(e=>({id:e.id,n:e.n,s:e.s}));
 const meId=shared?uid:lastLocal;
 $('rs').textContent=(shared?'🌐 친구들과 함께하는 전체 랭킹':'📱 이 기기 랭킹')+(msg?' · '+msg:'');
 const ol=$('rl');ol.innerHTML='';
 if(!list.length){const li=document.createElement('li');li.textContent='아직 기록이 없어요';ol.appendChild(li);return}
 list.forEach((e,i)=>{const li=document.createElement('li');if(e.id===meId)li.className='me';
  const a=document.createElement('span');a.textContent=(i<3?['🥇','🥈','🥉'][i]:(i+1)+'위')+' '+e.n;
  const b=document.createElement('b');b.textContent=e.s+'점';li.append(a,b);ol.appendChild(li)})}
(async()=>{try{if(typeof claude==='undefined')return;const u=await claude.use('user'),d=await claude.use('db');if(!u||!d)return;uid=await u.id();if(!uid)return;db=d;
 db.collection('scores').orderBy('best','desc').limit(30).onSnapshot(s=>{
  rows=s.docs.map(d=>{const v=d.data()||{};return{id:d.id,n:String(v.name||'익명').slice(0,8),s:Number(v.best)||0}});
  shared=true;const m=rows.find(r=>r.id===uid);myBest=m?m.s:0;updBest();
  if($('rank').classList.contains('on'))renderRank()},()=>{shared=false})}catch(e){}})();
async function saveScore(){
 const n=($('nm').value.trim()||'익명').slice(0,8),s=Math.floor(score);try{localStorage.setItem('poopName',n)}catch(e){}
 let ok=false;msg='';
 if(db&&uid){try{const old=await db.doc('scores/'+uid).get();const od=old&&old.data?old.data():null;const ob=(od&&Number(od.best))||0;
  await db.doc('scores/'+uid).set({name:n,best:Math.max(ob,s),at:Date.now()});ok=true;msg=s>ob?'등록 완료!':'기존 최고점이 더 높아요'}catch(e){ok=false;msg='공유 권한이 없어 이 기기에만 저장돼요'}}
 if(!ok){shared=false;const r=loadL();lastLocal='L'+Date.now();r.push({id:lastLocal,n,s});r.sort((a,b)=>b.s-a.s);saveL(r.slice(0,10))}
 updBest();$('b-save').style.display='none';renderRank();show('rank');$('b-back').onclick=()=>show('over')}
$('b-save').onclick=saveScore;
/* ---------- game ---------- */
function start(){initAudio();squeak();show(null);run=true;px=tx=W/2;items=[];t=0;score=0;sp=0;ded=0;acc=0;mv=0;last=performance.now();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
function end(){run=false;drag=null;squeak(0.55);$('fs').textContent=Math.floor(score)+'점';$('nm').value=localStorage.getItem('poopName')||'';$('b-save').style.display='';show('over')}
$('b-start').onclick=start;$('b-again').onclick=start;
$('b-rank').onclick=()=>{msg='';$('b-back').onclick=()=>show('menu');renderRank();show('rank')};
$('b-back').onclick=()=>show('menu');
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.key]=1});addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key]=0});
c.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(!run)return;try{c.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}drag={sx:e.clientX,spx:tx};squeak(1.1)});
c.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!drag||!run)return;const r=c.getBoundingClientRect(),old=tx;
 tx=Math.max(24,Math.min(W-24,drag.spx+(e.clientX-drag.sx)*W/r.width));mv+=Math.abs(tx-old);if(mv>140){mv=0;squeak(0.9+Math.random()*0.3)}});
const up=()=>{drag=null};c.addEventListener('pointerup',up);c.addEventListener('pointercancel',up);
function spawn(){
 if(t>6&&Math.random()<0.28)items.push({k:'p',x:40+Math.random()*(W-80),y:-40,r:26,v:sp*0.8,i:imgs[Math.floor(Math.random()*imgs.length)],a:0,ph:Math.random()*6});
 else items.push({k:'d',x:20+Math.random()*(W-40),y:-30,r:15,v:sp*(0.85+Math.random()*0.5),a:0})}
function loop(n){if(!run)return;const dt=Math.min((n-last)/1000,0.05);last=n;t+=dt;score+=dt*10;
 sp=260+300*(1-Math.exp(-t/12))+t*5;            // 점점 빨라지지만 한계가 있음
 if(keys.ArrowLeft||keys.a)tx-=330*dt;if(keys.ArrowRight||keys.d)tx+=330*dt;
 tx=Math.max(24,Math.min(W-24,tx));px+=(tx-px)*Math.min(1,dt*18);
 acc+=dt;const gap=Math.max(0.1,0.25+0.3*Math.exp(-t/12)-t*0.0015);if(acc>gap){acc=0;spawn()}
 const py=H-48;
 for(const o of items){o.y+=o.v*dt;o.a+=dt*3;if(o.k==='p')o.x+=Math.sin(o.a+o.ph)*50*dt;
  if(Math.hypot(o.x-px,o.y-py)<o.r+19){end();draw();return}}
 items=items.filter(o=>{if(o.y>H+40){score+=o.k==='p'?20:5;if(++ded%15===0)squeak(1.2);return false}return true});
 draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
function club(){const ph=t%30;if(ph<12||ph>=24)return;
 const k=Math.min(1,(ph-12)/1.5,(24-ph)/1.5),beat=Math.floor(t*2.2),hue=(beat*67)%360;
 x.save();x.globalAlpha=k;
 x.fillStyle='hsla('+hue+',100%,55%,'+(0.07+0.07*(beat%2))+')';x.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
 for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const ox=W*(i+0.5)/4,a=Math.sin(t*1.6+i*1.9)*0.7,L=H*0.95,w=46;
  const ex=ox+Math.sin(a)*L,ey=Math.cos(a)*L,g=x.createLinearGradient(ox,0,ex,ey);const h=(hue+i*90)%360;
  g.addColorStop(0,'hsla('+h+',100%,65%,0.38)');g.addColorStop(1,'hsla('+h+',100%,65%,0)');
  x.fillStyle=g;x.beginPath();x.moveTo(ox-5,0);x.lineTo(ox+5,0);x.lineTo(ex+w,ey);x.lineTo(ex-w,ey);x.closePath();x.fill()}
 x.restore()}
function draw(){x.clearRect(0,0,W,H);club();
 x.textAlign='center';x.textBaseline='middle';
 for(const o of items){
  if(o.k==='d'){x.font='34px serif';x.save();x.translate(o.x,o.y);x.rotate(Math.sin(o.a)*0.3);x.fillText('💩',0,0);x.restore()}
  else{x.save();x.translate(o.x,o.y);x.rotate(Math.sin(o.a)*0.25);x.beginPath();x.arc(0,0,27,0,7);x.fillStyle='#fff';x.fill();
   x.lineWidth=4;x.strokeStyle='#e63946';x.stroke();x.drawImage(o.i,-25,-25,50,50);x.restore()}}
 if(pig.complete)x.drawImage(pig,px-30,H-48-30,60,60);
 $('sc').textContent='점수 '+Math.floor(score)}
updBest();draw();
</script></body></html>
